ХРЕБЕТ - roof loop (header line, rail lines, rear-window cross line) - new label
rear window - inside the greenhouse loop behind the rear cross line: glass framed by 1.5-3 cm of paint, no label

ПЯТАЧОК - nose: hood front between the hood cut line and the front cut line over the grille, running on over the fender tops and window frames (between the greenhouse line and the shoulder line) to the rear quarter tops and the trunk lid behind the trunk line (ХВОСТИК): the cut lines do not separate these - they are one band round the greenhouse, ended at the tail by the trunk lid's lower shut line and the tail lamps

ГУЗКА - rear panel / bumper between the tail lamps: closed by the two loop risers (from the lamps' inner ends down), the rear bumper line between them and, at the top, the tail lamps and the trunk lid's lower shut line (a hard body edge, like the wheel openings and lamps elsewhere: no cut line is drawn across the rear panel, which carries the КОМАНДА ЭДМ / Молодь decals) - new label ГУЗКА, with the ——◆—— underline of the cut-label style, on the bumper's top roll between the rear URL and the bumper / rear-panel shut line

ЛОПАТКА / КОРЕЙКА - the side between the shoulder line and the belly line, from the front cut line behind the headlight to the belly line's stem, which meets the shoulder line in a T ahead of the tail lamp (front fender: ЛОПАТКА + the truffle-hunter pig; rear doors: КОРЕЙКА)

between the stem and the tail lamp - the shoulder line's last ~12 cm before it bends down round the lamp, the loop's descent and the flare step's edges close a sliver of the under-cut band (~7 cm tall) and the step's top: too small for a label in the size class with 2 cm of air - no label (as the step's triangle before)

ЩЕКА - front bumper corner and face beside the outer intake: under the front cut line, above the holo band, from the outer intake to the belly line's riser (now on the corner's outboard part, so the forward-facing face is free) - it carries the corner URL, which has priority: the label is skipped (no room for it with air; the 8-10 cm strip between the riser and the wheel opening, closed by the belly line's lower run, stays plain)

КРЕСТЕЦ - behind the tail lamp: the loop under the lamp, its riser, the trim fin and the flare's trailing edge (the recess under the flare stays plain pink; the label sits on the bumper corner's vertical rear face under the bumper's fold - one face, projected) - new label

ГРУДИНКА / ОКОРОК / ПОДБРЮШИНА - the lower band (holo) under the belly line and the rear bumper line, round the nose under the intakes: ГРУДИНКА front door, ОКОРОК rear door, ПОДБРЮШИНА new label - on the front door's band, centred per side in the free stretch between ГРУДИНКА and the SMP RACING plaque (the same air to both)
